You are not going to go from black to platinum blonde with this its just not possible. It might lighten 1-3 shades depending on how frequently you use it.

All you need to do really is put a table spoon or so of honey in a bowl and mix with the juice of 1 or 2 lemons. Then put it in your hair. You can put a plastic bag, saran wrap or a plastic shower cap over your hair as well, the heat speeds the bleaching.

Sitting in the sun can also speed up the process, but be careful since lemon juice makes your skin, including your scalp, more sensitive to sunlight and you might get burned.

Sit with it for around 30-40 minutes, if you are sitting in the sun I wouldnt recommend more than 10 minutes or so. Your hair might feel a little dry afterwards but its nothing some conditioner wont help with.
